title: Triple Crown gstack Quality, Security & Release Bridge
description: Adds GSD-owned ship authorization, release/deployment evidence, and safe post-ship adapters for gstack canary, document-release, and retro.

notes.*: Triple Crown validates the concrete Claude Code/gstack/Superpowers host dependencies in its installer/doctor. The GSD capability overlay itself avoids concrete runtime-registry coupling.

triple_crown.gstack.plan_review_required.description: Block plan:post until the current plan set has been interactively reviewed with gstack and marked current.

triple_crown.gstack.code_review_enabled.description: Run the Triple Crown gstack code-review bridge at execute:post.

triple_crown.gstack.review_skill_id.description: Exact gstack review skill id exposed by the host. Change when the installation uses a namespaced id.

triple_crown.gstack.verify_mutations.description: Require fresh post-review verification evidence whenever gstack review mutates repository state.

triple_crown.gstack.qa_enabled.description: Run report-only gstack QA after code review and seed its results into GSD UAT.

triple_crown.gstack.qa_skill_id.description: Exact gstack report-only QA skill id exposed by the host.

triple_crown.gstack.security_enabled.description: Enable the independent gstack CSO audit integration.

triple_crown.gstack.security_mode.description: When the gstack CSO audit runs.

triple_crown.gstack.security_trigger_at.description: Minimum deterministic phase risk that triggers CSO in risk-based mode.

triple_crown.gstack.security_skill_id.description: Exact gstack CSO skill id exposed by the host.

triple_crown.gstack.security_block_on.description: Minimum open gstack CSO finding severity that blocks ship.

triple_crown.ship.owner.description: Canonical ship/PR owner for a GSD-controlled Triple Crown project.

triple_crown.ship.guard_enabled.description: Arm the Claude Code ship-effect guard during GSD ship.

triple_crown.ship.authorization_ttl_seco.description: Short-lived GSD ship authorization window for protected remote effects.

triple_crown.gstack.post_ship_enabled.description: Run the release-ledger post-ship adapter after GSD creates the PR.

triple_crown.gstack.document_release_mod.description: Whether gstack document-release may run automatically while the GSD-created PR is open.

triple_crown.gstack.document_release_ski.description: Exact gstack document-release skill id exposed by the host.

triple_crown.gstack.document_release_all.description: Allow VERSION to be included in the docs-only post-ship push authorization.

triple_crown.gstack.canary_mode.description: Run canary only when release evidence proves a matching deployment.

triple_crown.gstack.canary_skill_id.description: Exact gstack canary skill id exposed by the host.

triple_crown.gstack.canary_duration.description: Duration passed to gstack canary when monitor-if-deployed mode is used.

triple_crown.gstack.retro_mode.description: Retro is weekly/sprint-oriented; default is manual rather than every PR.

triple_crown.gstack.retro_skill_id.description: Exact gstack retro skill id exposed by the host.

triple_crown.gstack.retro_window.description: Window passed to gstack retro when invoked automatically.
